purpose: 단계93까지 시험하지 못한 진행 중 true 알림(Syncing=true)의 구독 세대 경계를 실제 owner ack 기준으로 관측한다. 긴 체인을 동기화하는 도중 receiver의 유일한 peer를 끊어 원래 60초 타이머가 CurrentBlock < HighestBlock 상태에서 progress를 보내게 한다
requirement_source: docs/spec-driven/MACHINE-HANDOFF.md 5절, CURRENT-HANDOFF.md 다음 작업, REMAINING-13-EXECUTION.json next (stage 93)
source_condition: eth/downloader/api.go eventLoop: the 60s timer sends SyncingResult{Syncing: true} when a StartEvent was seen and SyncProgress.Done() is false (CurrentBlock < HighestBlock or TxIndexRemainingBlocks > 0); Downloader.Progress keeps HighestBlock at the height known when sync started
feasibility_probe: an uninstrumented throwaway program in the session scratch clone received a real Syncing=true at the 60s timer after the peer was removed (2000 and 1024 blocks, general and race); not archived as evidence

execution_adapter.instrumentation: docs/spec-driven/operational-preparation/source-review-supplement/followups/wiv1-transport-timer-generation-v1/drivers/transport_instrument.py.gz, byte-identical; the existing c <- notification rule already traces progress sends
execution_adapter.fresh_upstream_clone: https://github.com/stable-net/go-stablenet.git at the pinned commit; the run driver re-checks the retained inventory

fixture.chain: legacy PoW ethash faker, 1024 blocks generated before either node exists so the API timer is not consumed by generation
fixture.peer_loss: receiver.Server().RemovePeer(seeder) once the receiver head reaches 1; the sync fails with no peers and stays below the seeder head
fixture.restore: progress-to-done only: AddPeer again, wait for DoneEvent, head equal to the seeder and the transaction indexer complete

added_events: native_send_begin_progress carries the downloader progress read at the send (observation only)
actual_RPC_unsubscribe_begin: emitted before eth_unsubscribe, because the call returns after the server has ended the subscription

progress-retained.old_generation: the first eligible 60s timer sends progress to the selected RPC callback, which forwards it; a real client eth_unsubscribe ends it; real owner ack
progress-retained.regeneration: same-channel generation 2 and a new eth_subscribe on the same connection; the sync stays stalled, so the next timer broadcasts progress to both

progress-to-done.regeneration: same-channel generation 2 and a new eth_subscribe; the peer is restored and the real sync completes; the next timer broadcasts done to both

expected.install_send: none, since the sync is not done when the registrations are installed
expected.MUT-EARLY: Unsubscribe returns without an uninstall request; each generation is cleaned by an owned manual uninstall that is counted

out_of_scope: progress caused by TxIndexRemainingBlocks > 0 with the block sync complete
operational WBFT; legacy PoW ethash fixture
independent oracle, approved positive role, final HEAD
